# Claudio Dashboard

> Progressive Web Application for parcel couriers: automated WhatsApp report ingestion, real-time financial tracking, debt deduction, and multi-device Google Cloud Firestore synchronization.

## Project Resources
- [Production Web Application](https://claudio-dashboard-app.web.app/)
- [Source Code Repository](https://github.com/ClaudioCeppi83/claudio-dashboard)
- [Web App Manifest](https://claudio-dashboard-app.web.app/manifest.webmanifest)
- [Search Engine Sitemap](https://claudio-dashboard-app.web.app/sitemap.xml)

## Core Capabilities
- **Smart WhatsApp Report Parsing**: Ingests individual daily reports or batch chats exported from WhatsApp, extracting delivery counts, routes, incidents, and automatically attributing reports to the active user.
- **Dynamic Financial Metrics**: Calculates gross earnings based on delivered parcels (€/delivery), subtracts active debts and recurring fixed expenses, and projects available net balance.
- **Daily Breakdown Calendar**: Tabulates active delivery days within the month, detects intermediate rest days ("días libres"), and prevents speculative future projections.
- **Offline & Cloud Dual Storage**: Supports instant local-first operation via browser storage (`.cld` NDJSON backup import/export) and seamless multi-device persistence via Google Cloud Firestore with Google Authentication.
